result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends on your business size, where you operate, and how you pay your employees.

**My recommendation: Gusto for US-based small businesses, or Xero Payroll for many UK-based small businesses.**

If you're operating in the UK, I would approach this differently from US payroll because PAYE, HMRC Real Time Information (RTI), pensions and auto-enrolment are important requirements.

## Best payroll software to consider

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall UK choice)

- Standalone payroll software.
- HMRC submissions and pension auto-enrolment.
- Employee payslips and payroll reporting.
- Indicative pricing from £12/month for five employees.

Best for small businesses wanting straightforward UK payroll.

[Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero Payroll**

- Excellent accounting integration.
- Automates PAYE and RTI submissions.
- Workplace pension support.
- Particularly convenient if you already use Xero.

Best for businesses already using Xero accounting.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BrightPay**

- Comprehensive payroll functionality.
- Strong pension auto-enrolment tools.
- Good reporting and year-end processing.
- Particularly good for more involved payroll.

Best for businesses with more complex payroll needs.

[BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Payroll Premium](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gzLXXyNv7IycLWW5M_-XGhygM-VlRAnVi7K8LhQoXiEGeCE_bXOZ1XTn8xNFSMvEKz_nNQ-GLCCRqm8QWFpBgjZGDou6Ad3CP1dZyWCdA-8Ga_dtrpvLkasYDGH5BlpUmtG6KNovkUi5DeFcCzBNAhJDFVERO-One2cd33Zr_k7z6xCtL9hbWlIMDGTA_QNA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Integrates payroll with bookkeeping.
- HMRC submissions.
- Pension and payslip management.

Best for existing QuickBooks customers.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Employment Hero**

- Payroll combined with HR.
- Employee management and onboarding.
- Holiday and absence management.

Best for businesses wanting payroll and HR together.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

These are based on UK payroll comparisons for 2026. [smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[gosmallbusiness.co.uk](https://gosmallbusiness.co.uk/best-payroll-software-for-small-businesses-in-the-uk/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would check before buying

Make sure the software supports\:

- HMRC PAYE and RTI submissions.
- National Insurance and statutory deductions.
- Workplace pension auto-enrolment.
- Holiday pay and statutory sick pay.
- P45s, P60s and payslips.
- Integration with your accounting software.

You can also check the official [HMRC-recognised payroll software list](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-payroll-software-that-is-recognised-by-hmrc?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\.
